_comment: Every GitHub Actions variable (`vars.NAME`) a workflow still reads, and why it has not
holds this file set-equal with the reads it derives from the tree, in BOTH directions,
and re-derives every entry's `kind` rather than believing it.
THE RULING. The operator, 2026-09-24: no dependency on GitHub variables or secrets at
all. The one exception is BWS_ACCESS_TOKEN, because a credential cannot live inside the
store it unlocks; that ruling is `bootstrap_names` in .ci/config/secret-supply.json and
the gate reads it from there rather than restating it here. GITHUB_TOKEN is minted per
job by the runner, stored nowhere, and is the other name the secrets arm allows.
THE TERMINAL STATE IS AN EMPTY `vars` OBJECT, and it is the state this file is in. All
twenty variable names moved to the ci-shared project on 2026-09-24
(agent/plans/PLAN-github-actions-to-bitwarden.md). An entry here is a debt with a
reason, not a record of history: an entry whose reads have all gone reds as RESOLVED.
HOW TO ADD ONE, if a workflow genuinely needs a GitHub variable again. Add
ci-shared spelling when it differs from NAME. `no-fetch-job` also needs a

kinds.migrated: The value is already in ci-shared (under `bws`, or under NAME when `bws` is absent) and the remaining reads are the edit still to land. Re-derived: the twin must be in .ci/config/bws-secret-map.json.
kinds.no-fetch-job: Read ONLY in jobs that must not fetch from Bitwarden, each named under `no_fetch_jobs` with a BLOCKER reason. Re-derived: every read of the name sits in such a job, and every such job still contains the read.
kinds.dead: Nothing reads it. Unreachable by construction and refused on sight: a dead variable is deleted from GitHub, not recorded here.
